dataList.content:
Well, then. This is where we will go our separate ways... for a short while.
好，我们就此暂别吧。
dataList.place:
U Corp.'s Marlin Portship
U公司 马林鱼港船

dataList.content:
Charon and I have business to attend to here.
我跟卡戎在这附近还有事要做。

Business? Why? What is it this time~?
有事？为什么？这次又是去干嘛~？

... I'm looking to buy some Mermaid perfume. Let's leave it at that.
这么说吧……我想要去买些人鱼香水。

Vergilius said, looking straight at an advertisement before us.
维吉里乌斯直视着我们身前的一张广告板如是说道。

'Bottles of Mermaid Perfume, extracted straight from their left fins! Special discount!'
“人鱼香水，源自左鳍，跳楼价售卖中！”

Oho! Art thou planning to procure some for us as well? Quite curious I am, of that 'Mermaid Perfume'. What other curiosities of the Great Lake await us, I wonder?
哦哦？汝也打算为吾等购置一些吗？吾对“人鱼香水”很是好奇。大湖中不知还有何等珍品正静待吾等呢！

A significant source of income for the people of U Corp. comes from selling Whale and Mermaid products. Whale oil, Mermaid tears, Mermaid perfumes, Whale cuisine, and more, to list a few examples.
鲸和人鱼产品是U公司的主要收入来源。这些产品包括鲸油、人鱼之泪、人鱼香水、鲸肉菜肴等等，不胜枚举。

Ooo! Lo! I spy a purveyor of iced creams over yonder!
哦哦！吾发现那边有家冰淇淋店！

… Sardine Whale flavored ice cream…? How is that appetizing to you?
沙丁鲸味的冰淇淋……？你真的想吃吃看吗？

… Sardines are quite the savoury nosh, even if they do have a funny look to them.
……虽然看起来很奇怪，但沙丁鲸意外地可以入口……

Alas, I am more keen to learn the flavors of the Marlin Whale ice cream...
相较于沙丁鲸味，吾更想尝尝看马林鲸味冰淇淋的味道……

Will you not accompany us to our destination, dear guide?
向导您此次也不与我们同行吗？

... I've done my job as your guide.
……我已经尽职完成了作为你们向导的职责。

I point you in the right direction, and that's where my responsibilities end. It's not my job to accompany you all the way there.
我的职责仅是为你们指出正确的前进方向，不包括陪你们前往那里。

While you may be correct... your words also come across as rather impersonal.
……也许如您所言，但听着仍有些不近人情。

Then you heard me right, Yi Sang. I don't intend to make friends with any of you. Nor do I want to.
你没听错，李箱。因为我既不想与你们彼此了解，也不想与你们分享什么。

Hah. Don't let these small talks give you the wrong impression.
哈，真是的。就是这种闲聊才会让人觉得我容易亲近。

Now, Ms. Faust.
浮士德女士。

Our allies are expecting us.
有盟友在等着我们。

The Before Team on the ground will relay us the location of the Lobotomy Corp. Branch housing the Golden Bough.
他们是事先派遣到U公司内的LCCB员工，负责向我们传达保存着金枝的脑叶公司支部位置的消息。

According to our last communication, they should be waiting for us... there.
根据我们间的最后一次通讯，他们应该在……那里等着我们。

This place is a bit spooky...
这地方有点瘆人……
dataList.place:
Dark Corners of U Corp.
U公司 深处某处

dataList.content:
I don't see anyone here. What's up with that, Fau?
这里一个人也没有？怎么回事，小浮？

... I can tell from your tone that you doubt me. This is the location I was relayed.
……你的语气是在质疑我呢。这里就是我收到的碰面位置。

Huh, so we got here first? Bloody Brilliant. Before team? More like Belated team, innit?
哈，所以说这次我们先到了？看来所谓先遣部队的行事风格跟他们的名号不太符合啊，嗯？

Allow me to make a minor correction. We arrived about 1 hour and 30 minutes behind schedule.
请允许我稍作纠正。我们比预计到达时间大概晚了1小时30分钟。

Hm, odd. LCCB Agents we met back at J Corp were already on the scene and...
嗯，是很奇怪。我们之前在J公司遇见的LCCB队员都是很早就就位了……

I'm sure that comment reminded everyone of the same duo.
大家的脑中，都浮现出同一对令人怀念的二人组形象。

It did for me, too.
对我来说也是一样。

Thinking about them even for a brief moment is...
哪怕只是稍许回想起他们也会……

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
Snrk! Snore...
呼！噜……

It appears that they have elected to sleep in lieu of our appearance.
他们似乎在我们到来前以入睡来消磨时间。

Effie, Saude... We didn't deserve you two.
埃菲，索德。我总觉得对不起你们。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
Ungh... Ain't none of ye got a watch, eh?! What the hell's wrong with ye lot?!
嗯……现在都几点了，现在才到是不是太晚了点？啊？！

Ah... Apologies... In our hurry, we happened upon an unforeseen mishap on our journey here...
啊……抱歉……在赶向这里的半路上，我们遭遇了一场意外事故……

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
Gah, then why didn'tcha take that into account before ye left? Yawn~
哈，那你们就该料到会发生这种事，早点出发啊~呼啊~

Someone, from the corner of the shipping container, rises from their nap and stretches.
集装箱群的角落里有人从睡梦中醒来，伸了个懒腰。

<They sound... oddly aggressive...>
<这语气好像奇怪地有些粗暴……>

My, my!
哎呀，这可不行。

<Hong Lu, wait—>
<鸿璐，等等……！>

Your badge is upside-down. Remember to always keep your appearance tidy!
您的名牌颠倒过来了。请记住始终保持仪容整洁是很重要的！

Huh? What's this sticky red thing on your...
诶，您名牌上这粘着的东西是……

On his chest hung an upside-down LCCB Agent badge.
他的胸前倒挂着一张LCCB队员的名牌。

It was soaked in blood.
血将其浸透了。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
... Yawn. I hoped that this badge would have a more dramatic effect.
……呼啊。我还希望这个名牌能起到更戏剧化的效果呢。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
Let's see 'ere~ Limbus Company... Before Team... Team Leader.
来看看~呃，写着什么。边狱……公司……先遣部队……队长……

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
The fool was loitering around in our territory. I've gots to say, that was bravely stupid.
这个不知好歹的傻子在我们的地盘上绕来绕去，碍手碍脚。

Hmph. That sorry production was an insult to art. Get to the point before I SYNC.
哼。这种低劣表演简直是有辱艺术。在我折·脖前赶紧说重点。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
Phew, lads! So tardy, yet so impatient. Why don't ye first give us a listen?
呵，来的那么迟还这么没耐心。给我听好。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
Yer lookin' fer... the Golden... whatchamacallit, aren't ye?
你们……在找金……什么什么的对吧？

What have you done to the Team Leader?
你们对他做了什么？

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
Hold your horses now. Lad's alive and well.
啊，别急。那家伙还活着。

This is a hostage negotiation, then.
那么这就是一场人质谈判了吧。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
This ain't me first ransom rodeo, if ye know what I mean.
哼，我们已经跟别人做过很多次这种赎金交易了。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
'Tis simple. Give us the cash, and we return yer friend.
很简单。给我们钱，我们就放了你们的朋友。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
We don't get the cash, and we give yer friend an impromptu burial in a shipping container, right 'ere.
不给的话？这里的集装箱就会变成你们朋友的棺材了。

Kidnappers, eh... Pieces of shite...
绑匪啊……肮脏的人渣……

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
Woah, woah! I wouldn't do that if I were ye, laddie. Think before ye act, eh?
哦~等下等下。真性急啊。你们当中好像有些人做事不经大脑啊？

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
Anything goes wrong, and yer friend bites it.
出了任何差错，你们的朋友都会进棺材。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
It's very straightforward if I do say so meself. Just do as we say, and ye and that friend of yours continue on yer merry adventure. Get back to findin' yer Golden... whatchamacallit.
只要干净利落地给钱，你们就可以和被释放的朋友一起去寻找那金……什么什么的玩意。这不是很简单吗？

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
Hells, we'll even throw in a full-on gourmet tour guide for ye. Just to sweeten the deal.
然后为了让这笔交易更令人开心，我们还会派人给你们当美食向导。是售后服务哦。

... You bloody maggot...
……你这该死的臭虫……

Okay, okay... Gotcha. I see what's going on here. Give us some time to discuss this, why don't you?
好了好了……明白了。你们说的我们完全明白了。给我们点时间讨论一下吧，嗯？

Look, there's no point in escalating this. It'll do nothing but draw unnecessary attention to us.
听着，我们要是在这把事闹大引起不必要的注意，对我们一点好处也没有……

And if our impulsive actions get that LCCB Agent killed...
如果我们的冲动行为真的导致LCCB队员被杀了……

True. They hold the upper hand in this negotiation.
诚然，在这次谈判当中我们占据着不利地位。

But I don't believe these fools know much about the Golden Bough. They likely kidnapped him by chance, thinking they could get a hefty ransom out of him.
但我不觉得这些蠢货对于金枝非常了解。他们很可能只是偶然绑架了他，以为可以从他身上榨出一大笔赎金。

Though we have come across many men and women of evil nature in our adventure, Such brazen villainy has heretofore not been encountered...
虽然至今为止有很多恶人曾试图抢夺金枝，但这是第一次被人不加思索地抢劫……

How classless. It is grotesquery without a cause.
真是一场肤浅空洞的演剧。

Charging them head-on will only sic their friends after us. Friends who may be involved with a powerful local Syndicate.
与他们正面交锋只会让他们的同僚不断追杀我们……而这些人很可能与当地的强大帮派有所关连。

Our chance of victory is slim, should such an event come to pass. We do not possess enough intel on U Corp. to effectively maneuver that situation.
如果发生这种情况，我们的胜算微乎其微。对没有足够多关于U公司的情报的我们来说，会陷入相当不利的状况。

Yeah... We don't even know how big the Syndicate behind this guy is. But from the way he said his lines... this probably isn't his first time doing this, right?
是哦……我们甚至不知道这些家伙们背后的靠山帮派规模有多大。但从他的话来看，这可能不是他第一次这么干吧……？

Um... then there's also a chance that they're just small fries, isn't there?
嗯……但他们也有可能只是规模比较小的帮派不是吗？

If they're small fries, let's crush 'em all. We'll hit them before they even have the chance to lay a finger on the hostage!
要是规模不大的话，就把他们所有人都杀了不就得了？赶在他们杀掉人质前！

... No. It could mean that their Syndicate may be so small and scattered that it is impossible to be traced.
……不。就算跟你说的一样规模并不大，但那也可能成为另一麻烦点。组不成帮派体系……也就是说规模可能小到无法追踪也说不定。

Ugh...
呃……

<So we don't know anything... Great.>
<所以我们最后还是什么都……不知道啊。>

Are they really going to... If we don't pay up...
我们不给钱的话……他们真的会……

Blast it. I know their kind. Scum like them are around every corner of the City. If this goes cock-up, they'll kill the hostage and won't even leave a body for us to find.
妈的……我了解他们这种人。都市里的每个角落都有这种人渣。要是这事搞砸了，他们会把人质杀了之后毁尸灭迹。

All kinds of awful images and ominous speculation begin to overwhelm us.
种种可怕的想象画面和推论，逐渐将我们推向被消极想法侵蚀的方向上。

The so-called kidnappers were crowding amongst themselves, giggling and chattering. They knew that our options were limited.
那些绑匪一样的人聚在一起，悠闲且叽叽喳喳地聊着笑着。他们知道我们并没有多少选择权。

<Okay... Then I'm going to start off by asking how much they want.>
<总之……我们需要问问他们想要多少东西。>

We're out of our element here... The best I can do is to try to gather some information, at least.
因为没什么确切明白的事……所以我们必须得获得一些信息。

Huh.
呵。

A short, exasperated sigh escaped Ishmael's lips. She had been standing here this whole time, arms crossed over the harpoon that rested upon her chest.
双手交叉放在胸前鱼叉上的以实玛利嘴里发出了空气流出的声音。

You're going to pay them? Those bastards? Are you crazy?
给钱？给那群混账？你们终于疯了吗？

<What else can we do? Even now, the hostage...>
<没别的办法了。即使是现在人质也……>

I don't care about your excuses.
我对你的反驳没有兴趣。

I only care to know if this really is the best course of action you could come up with.
我只想知道，这是不是经理您能想到的最好的解决方法？

Any doubts about the manager's decisions—
对经理决定的任何疑虑……

'—are unnecessary'. Yeah. You're as predictable as always.
“都没有必要”。是，你肯定会这么说。

Executive Manager's decisions are orders. To doubt them is insubordination. Ishmael, it doesn't matter how competent of a seadog you are—
执行经理的决定即是命令。怀疑它们即是不服从命令。以实玛利，无论你是多么经验丰富的海猴子……

Hah, okay. If you say so. But who cares? They've not given me an order. They didn't forbid me from doing anything. So what's your problem here?
哈，好吧。可能是那样没错。不过无所谓，反正他又没直接给我下命令，也没禁止我做任何事。

... I just can't sit here and watch this play out.
……因为我已经忍无可忍了而已。

Ishmael strode toward the Kidnappers. It was plain from her tone and expression that she did not care one bit about what the other Sinners said.
以实玛利大步走向绑匪。从她的语气和表情来看，她并不在乎其他罪人们都说了些什么。

I'll gladly accept the consequences...
对不服从命令的处罚……

She shot me a fleeting glance before raising her harpoon.
在举起鱼叉前，她稍稍回头望了我一眼……

... for insubordination, manager.
您方便时再进行吧，经理。

Then thrust her well-sharpened harpoon right into one of the kidnappers' forehead.
然后，她把磨得锋利的鱼叉直直插入其中一名绑匪的前额。

The entire course of her action, from start to finish, was so full of absolute confidence, that...
以实玛利的行动是如此的自然，就像是理所应当一般，以至于……

... no one even thought to stop her.
根本没有人想到要去阻止她。

I couldn't, either.
我也一样如此。

O.O.F.
头·裂。

Ryōshū was right. The kidnapper... suffered a total obliteration of forehead.
正如良秀所说。面目狰狞的绑匪的头颅被打得裂开粉碎，惨不忍睹。

Ishmael...? What did you just...
以实玛利小姐……？你刚刚……

W-what did you just do?!
你、你刚刚做了什么？！

Sinclair was the first to snap out of this stupefied silence.
辛克莱率先打破这令人目瞪口呆的沉默，站了出来。

The LCCB Agent they took hostage... We just put him at risk...! Because of us, h-he could...!
如果我们这么做……被绑架的LCCB队员会被我们推入险境的……因为我们，他、他会……！

Sinclair was trembling hard. I couldn't tell if it was the welling tears he was holding back... or an uncontrollable fury.
辛克莱在剧烈颤抖着。我分不清他是在强忍着泪水……还是处于极度的愤怒之中。

Just like then...! Just like back then with... Effie, with Saude...!
就像那时候的……埃菲先生……和索德小姐……一样！

It was only few months ago when...! Don't tell me you've moved on already!
就在……就在几个月之前不是吗……！别告诉我你这就放下了！

Sinclair's... memories?
这是辛克莱的……记忆？

I saw an image of Saude and Effie—both smiling. Both were excellent field Agents.
我看到了微笑着的索德和埃菲。他们都是非常出色的作战队员……

And because they were both excellent Agents, they suffered to their last moments before our eyes.
也正因为他们都是非常出色的作战队员，他们才在我们眼前饱受折磨，直到最后一刻。

Helplessly watching as they slowly expired in front of him, at his old home at that...
在他的家乡，他的眼前。只能无助地眼睁睁看着他们的生命消逝却什么也做不到的辛克莱一定……

That day must have been scorched into his memories.
那一天，绝对深深烙印在了他的记忆之中。

I recalled Ishmael's vision that I witnessed back at the Boatworks.
我想起了在修船厂时目睹到的以实玛利的过去。

... Was that also a moment that was burned into her memories, I wonder...
……我想那也是深深烙印在了以实玛利记忆中的时刻吧。

Ishmael didn't seem to find Sinclair's questions worth answering. She strode toward one of the closed shipping containers and kicked it open.
以实玛利似乎不愿回答辛克莱的问题，她继续大步流星地走着，用脚“咚”的一声踢了踢其中一个封闭的集装箱。

A body, that had been dead for so long that its complexion and consistency barely resembled that of a living human, slumped to the floor.
从那之中，无力地倒下一具面目全非的尸体，看上去似乎已经经过了很长时间。

This one's been dead for at least a week. And of course, isn't our LCCB Agent.
这已经死了一周了。当然，这并不是LCCB队员。

Ishmael kicks the body, tossing it on its back.
以实玛利踢了踢尸体，把他翻过来。

From the looks of it, this one was a tourist visiting Marlin Port. Probably loaded too, if they could afford to travel to the Great Lake just for its sights. They would've been able to afford whatever ransom the pirates demanded.
从衣服上看……这个人应该是来马林鱼港旅游的。如果他们有能力来大湖旅游，那么他们一定也过着富裕的生活。无论开价多少赎金他们都付得起。

Kidnap. Extort. Execute. These Syndicates have been repeating these three steps for a good while at U Corp., even as their names and organizations changed with time. They're everywhere, like vermin.
绑架、勒索、杀人。虽然这些帮派的面貌在不断地一点点改变，但他们在U公司扎根已久，如杂草般无处不在。

It would be more accurate to call them 'pirates' here.
在这里，称他们为“海盗”更为准确。

They never return the hostages. They'll keep asking for more and more ransom until the money well dries up...
他们从不归还人质。他们只会不断地勒索更多的赎金，直到榨干对方……

Ishmael poked the body with her foot.
以实玛利用脚踢了踢尸体。

Then they kill the hostages. Like they did this one in.
再像这样杀掉人质。

... Quite numerous, the prevalence of such tragedies must be... How can this be? Wherefore doth no hero rise to the occasion and put a stop to these villains?
……这样的悲剧数不胜数……为什么这种情况会理所当然地发生？

I-I believed this to be a place of tourism, is it not?
这、这里是……旅游胜地不是吗？

Well... That usually means that there's a bigger fish looking out for these small fries.
这种情况下……通常意味着他们有强大的靠山。

Nay! That matters not! To let such villains run rampant in the City is...!
那又何妨！明明都市里游荡着如此多的恶人……！

Ah, it must be the case that the Fixers of the City are yet unaware of this travesty. Mayhaps they were preoccupied tending to others in need, indeed! Naught else but that explains this!
都、都市的收尾人们一定还不知道这件悲剧。否则，他们一定是正忙于照顾其他需要帮助的人们吧！

Were we to send a missive to one of the just and honorable Associations of the—
如果吾等现在就寄信给正义的协会的话……

Don Quixote... Please.
堂吉诃德小姐，拜托……

Isn't it about time you woke up from your delusions? I've had enough of your ramblings about 'justice'. Your 'villains'.
还在说些什么正义和恶人相关的话吗？事实摆在眼前你看不见吗？

Y-you know what? Nevermind. It's like I'm talking to a brick wall. You're not going to listen to me anyway. It's so frustrating to have to sit here and just...
没、没事……不必多说。反正说了也没用。这真的很令人沮丧，而且……

This shabbiness is... why we can't get anything done in time...
这就是为什么……我们无法及时完成任何事情……

By now, we should've been talking to the LCCB Agent, getting the intel we need...!
本来现在……我们应该已经从决定与我们碰面的LCCB队员那里取得了消息才对……

Ishmael's eyes darted around with wrath, impatience, and anxiety.
以实玛利的眼中充满了暴怒、急躁和焦虑，好像失去了自身的方向一般。

A metaphorical storm, an amalgamation of senses.
如一场风暴一般，卷起融合了多种感官。
